entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I... I hope you can help. I'm trying to return something but the website is just so confusing. I ordered a jersey and it's the wrong size.
I can certainly help you with that. Not to worry. Do you happen to have your order number?
Yes, I think so. It's... VF774-901. I just got so lost trying to find the right page. It's all a bit much.
I understand completely. Let me pull up that order for you, one moment... Okay, I see the ProFit Jersey, which was delivered on December 1st. Is that the item?
Yes, that's the one. It's just way too tight in the arms. I really need to exchange it for a bigger size. Can't you just help me? I don't know what to do.
Of course. Let's see... your order was delivered 11 days ago, so you are well within our 90-day return policy. I can go ahead and approve that for you right now.
Oh, really? Just like that? That's... a huge relief. Thank you.

You're very welcome. I've just initiated the process. I'm sending an email to you right now that will contain a pre-paid return label and all the instructions you'll need to send the jersey back for your exchange.
That's wonderful. I really appreciate it. You've made this so much easier.
It's my pleasure to help. Was there anything else for you today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, Diana.
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
